about.what: The safety rules for a sample page that the engine (ramen.site_page.html_problems) and Peek (lib/sample-page.ts checkPage) both load from this one file; Peek keeps a copy and its test fails with "copy the engine's file" when the copy's rules hash differs. The quality rules (numbers and names from the facts, quotes word for word, too generic, the WhatsApp button, area and stock phrases, design and uniqueness) are the engine's alone: they need the facts' meaning and feed the model; Peek is the safety gate. The contact rules are sample-contact-cases.json, the standing features sample-feature-cases.json.
decisions: menu_script_max 2,000 (engine 1,000, Peek 4,000; a toggle is a few hundred)
javascript: links, module scripts and unclosed scripts refused on both sides
menu_script_banned: the union of both lists; open_script_banned was already one
a reviewer's name is looked for outside <footer>; the footer's own rule stays no person's name (the contact rule)
noindex: Peek inserts it when missing, the engine's finish_page adds it
engine_slider_script_sha256: the engine's review slider script, the only third inline script, allowed by this exact hash

reviewer_display: a review card shows its reviewer's first name and last initial beside its own quote and nowhere else; a full last name or a picture of the reviewer is refused; reviewer_name_scope is no longer read by the engine
reviewer_second_line: the reviewer's line as the listing prints it ('Local Guide · 70 reviews · 701 photos') beside its own quote only
header_call_button: one tel: link in <header> to the business's own phone when WhatsApp is not confirmed (the number as text stays in the contact section)
engine_slider_script_sha256_previous: the slider before swipe and arrow keys, still on live pages, stays allowed

cases with "check" (reviewer | phone | photo) run with their own facts, row and phone and count only that check's reasons; the second line holds the listing's own words for the reviewer (Local Guide or not, the review count, the photo count), never a date or a source
sample_photos: a page may use photos/<name> (../photos/<name> on an extra page) only when <name> is on the sample's own photo list
about.hash_of: sha256 of the rules object as JSON with sorted keys, separators ',' and ':', UTF-8
